'''QO-77''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] of unknown origins available for purchase during the [[war against Zakuul]]. The unit was similar in appearance to [[QO-99]], a member of [[Specialists]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
QO-77 is a droid companion, added to the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] with Update 4.3 and available from the Visionary Cartel Pack.
